subject: Subprocessor ownership, license provenance and SOC2 evidence for runtime deps
messages:
From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@theracore.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-10-29T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: runtime dependency/subprocessor evidence for procurement

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. As part of our procurement and security intake for the TheraCore inference integration, our audit team has a few asks we need shared artifacts for by next Wednesday (2025-11-05):

- A flat mapping (CSV) of all subprocessors involved in the inference runtime path (model hosting, KV cache, metrics telemetry, ephemeral key escrow), including: provider name, service type, data residency, purpose, and contract owner.
- SBOM or dependency manifest for the runtime binaries we will be running against (Linux x86_64, typical inference config). If you cannot provide a full SBOM, we need a license provenance report (open-source licenses and any commercial third-party components).
- Copy of the latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) and the CAIQ/SIG mapping for Redwood's runtime.
- Confirmation of KMS residency for customer-specific keys (where KMS is hosted and whether keys leave Redwood's VPC).
- A single-point contact for oncall/incident escalation for the components above (name, email, phone).

Please indicate if any of this requires an NDA/lookup or if there are timing constraints on sharing full artifacts. We can take redacted artifacts and follow up with more targeted questions.

Appreciate the help — this is to clear our procurement bar.

Best,
Alex Soto
Compliance Manager, TheraCore
alex.soto@theracore.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Marissa / Ben / Laura —

Forwarding TheraCore's asks (below). Their deadline is 2025-11-05. High-level: they want CSV mapping of subprocessors, SBOM/license provenance, SOC2 (redacted OK), KMS residency confirmation, and an oncall contact for the runtime path.

Can Security (Marissa) own the artifact bundle + redaction call? Ben — would you run a quick license scan export from our build pipeline and confirm any commercial binaries we ship? Laura — can you confirm contract owners for the listed runtime partners and whether we can share the SOC2 redaction as-is?

Also: do we need any NDAs or sensitive gating before sharing the SBOM? If yes, flag and I'll request an NDA with Alex.

Thanks — I'll consolidate once I have the artifacts and aim to deliver a zipped bundle and a short summary table.

Thanks — quick status from Security:

1) Subprocessor CSV: I will produce subproc_matrix_v2025-10-30.csv. It will include provider, role, data types processed, residency, contract owner + link to contract (if shareable). Where contracts are non-shareable we will list owner + redaction note.

2) SBOM/license provenance: Ben, please export the license scan snapshot from the build pipeline (we usually have a CycloneDX JSON and a license-summary CSV). If we cannot release full CycloneDX, we will include the license-summary and a statement of commercial components.

3) SOC2: we can provide soc2_type2_2024_redacted.pdf (PII removed). Laura — confirm that the legal team is comfortable with the redaction level.

4) KMS residency: For customer-managed keys we use KMS hosted in us-west-2 (AWS KMS) and touch only our control plane for provisioning; keys do not leave the customer's VPC when using private deployments. I will attach kms_residency_snapshot.png showing the account-level config and the statement for Hosted vs Private.

5) Oncall contact: Ben Carter (infra SRE lead) will be the escalation contact for runtime infra (ben_carter@redwood.ai, +1 650 555 0199). For contract/ownership questions, Laura Bennett (legal ops) will be the escalation.

I will assemble the archive and upload a link by Friday EOD (2025-10-31). If TheraCore needs additional evidence (CAIQ mapping or SIG questionnaire filled), we can schedule a follow-up call next week.

Attachments (to be included in bundle): subproc_matrix_v2025-10-30.csv; runtime_sbom_2025-10-30.zip; soc2_type2_2024_redacted.pdf; kms_residency_snapshot.png

—
Marissa Cole

- runtime_sbom_2025-10-30.zip: a dependency snapshot generated from our build pipeline. Contains license-summary.csv and a CycloneDX JSON (commercial components redacted).

If you want a 30-minute walkthrough of the bundle and redactions, I'm available Thursday 11/6 between 9-12 PT — happy to book.
